name: @dxkjailbreak/dsh-campaign-memory
description: Campaign memory for the nine security presets + dxkjailbreak: model-side write/search/get/list/remove tools storing raw content verbatim (credentials may be stored as-is or as pointers to existing local vaults), a marker-tagged per-workspace recall block injected into every assembly (fresh workspace starts clean; cross-workspace recall is an explicit search with provenance labels), preview-capped retrieval with on-demand full-text fetch, usage-ranked with expiry for detection fingerprints, a loopback web channel, and a per-session tab for browsing, searching and curating memories. v1.2.1: merged single-card mode dxkjailbreak registered in MODE_IDS — recall/tools/gates armed for the new mode; composedPreset object form normalized; non-security sessions no longer fall back to redteam.
author: dxk
